messages:
laura: Heads-up — vendor portal flagged our PO for HelixGrid: 'billing entity mismatch' and 'export_control_flag'. PO rejected 409. Link: https://portal.marketplace.example/po/7711
ops-bot: PO 7711 rejected: BILLING_ENTITY_MISMATCH, EXPORT_CONTROL_FLAG. See troubleshooting guide: https://docs.marketplace/dev/po-validation#billing-entities
miguel: Oof. HelixGrid's legal gave us a signed SOW with US entity but reseller mapped to HelixGrid EU for currency reasons. Finance needs the reseller EIN or we have to route through partner billing. @rebecca any luck getting reseller EIN?
rebecca: Reseller says they provided EIN last week but portal lookup returns their old alias. I'm asking them to confirm tax ID and upload proof. Also checking export control flag: appears SKU 13-EXC is flagged for restricted regions. Partner claims it's classification error.
laura: That SKU was part of the APAC-special bundle for the joint launch next week. If the export flag stands we might have to remove it or delay announcement. Not great.
cal: Short-term options: 1) Remove SKU 13-EXC from PO and re-submit to unblock, 2) Manual ops ingestion with legal attestation (takes 2-3 business days and costs manual fees), 3) Partner fixes alias -> re-submit (depends on partner speed).
miguel: Partner prefers not to remove item -- it's core to launch. They said they'd reconcile their vendor alias in the marketplace console within 6 hours if we can hold. Ops-ingest would blow launch timeline and attract fees.
rebecca: I've asked partner to upload EIN + manufacturer declaration for 13-EXC. Also looped in their export control officer. ETA 3-4 hours. If they don't within that window, let's prepare a split PO without 13-EXC and a separate compliance ticket for the SKU.
laura: OK please prepare both paths. @cal can you draft the split-PO template and the ops-ingest request (include estimated manual fee)? Miguel, hold off on finalizing press assets until we confirm.
cal: Will do. Drafting now, will attach curl snippet for re-upload and a note for ops to mark as 'manual-accept: vendor-ein-verified'.
ops-bot: Re-upload API:
curl -X POST "https://portal.marketplace.example/api/v1/po/upload" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@po7711_split.xml"

rebecca: Partner just confirmed they started the alias update. I'll follow up in 90m. If nothing by then I'll request the split PO.
miguel: Thanks team. We'll try to keep launch on schedule but flagging this as urgent on the deal desk.
